research_question: Which models explain selected UAP observations, and can autonomous-probe or terrestrial-origin models generate distinguishing measurements?
evidence_policy: An unidentified sensor signature does not establish autonomy, replication, extraterrestrial origin, or nonhuman intelligence.

models.description: Aircraft, birds, balloons, satellites, meteorological effects, or sensor artifacts
predictions: Matches to known-object trajectories under stated uncertainties
Apparent rotations can follow camera optics
Photometric periodicity may match biological wingbeats
falsifiers: Independent calibrated tracks irreconcilable with all prespecified controls

models.description: Terrestrial human-developed unmanned or autonomous system
predictions: Kinematics consistent with engineered propulsion and energy budget
Potential RF links, manufacturing materials or deployment pattern
falsifiers: Verified physical measurements incompatible with prespecified engineering envelope

models.description: Speculative earlier terrestrial technological system or descendant autonomous machinery
predictions: Datable materials or industrial byproducts outside modern context
Independent geochemical, archaeological and isotopic anomalies with reproducible provenance
falsifiers: Supposed artifacts date to modern manufacture or natural origins

predictions: Repeated navigational or engineered signatures not reproduced by terrestrial controls
falsifiers: Confirmed mundane origin for the candidate artifact

models.description: Autonomous probe capable of obtaining resources and making viable descendants
predictions: Documented resource acquisition plus manufacture of functional daughter systems
Material and energy accounting consistent with replication
falsifiers: No physical replication evidence in a claim explicitly asserting observed self-replication
